A [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] with [[Color/Legends|dark]] skin was a '''princess''' from<ref name="CL" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &#x2014; Based on corresponding data for [[Soun system/Legends|Soun system]]</ref> astronomical object [[Soun IV/Legends|Soun IV]].<ref name="CL" /> During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'' depicts the [[Princess/Legends|princess]] from [[Soun IV/Legends|Soun IV]] visiting the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] at the same [[Time/Legends|time]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|visited]] the establishment during the events of {{Film|II}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the [[Princess/Legends|princess]] visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="CL" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CL" />

During their visit, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|interrogated]] the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] outside while the princess stood on the main [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] floor of the club next to an individual dressed in white. At the club, they wore a yellow [[Hat/Legends|hat]], a yellow and orange [[shirt]], a red [[Clothing/Legends|skirt]], and dark-colored shoes.<ref name="CL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Soun IV princess was first mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', authored by [[Simon Beecroft]] and [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The section of the book where the princess appeared was illustrated by [[Hans Jenssen]].<ref name="Artist">{{WebCite|url=https://www.hansjenssen.co.uk/star-wars-locations|text=''Star Wars Locations''|author=[[Hans Jenssen]]|archivedate=20190517022701}}</ref>
